title: Positive convolution powers of the uniform density
statement: Let $\phi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$ that is identically $1$, and let $d$ be a positive integer. The $d$-fold convolution power of $\phi$ is also identically $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\phi$ is the constant function with value $1$
